crossRefs.note: “ ‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not…
At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness…
One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two…
The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against…
It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
Don’t receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
For there are three who testify:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in…

translations.web: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
translations.bsb: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
translations.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
translations.asv: But if he hear thee not, take with thee one or two more, that at the mouth of two witnesses or three every word may be established.
